ここまで舎飼いで様子を見てきましたが、患部の反応は落ち着いてきました。今週から曳き運動を始める予定です。
先日の治療後は大きな反動もなく経過しています。乗り出し後の反応も今のところ落ち着いています。
日によって少し気分の波はありますが、全体としては落ち着いて運動できています。扱いにくさが強い印象はありません。
左前に少し熱感が残るため、運動後の冷却と定期的なショックウェーブ治療を続けています。歩様は安定しています。

notes:
The treatment and management instructions provided by Godolphin Castle Park consisted of one month of complete box rest, followed by one month of restricted paddock exercise. These recommendations were followed; however, the resulting improvement in her lameness was minimal.
Further ultrasound and radiographic examinations of the distal forelimbs were performed by Watanabe Sensei of Monbetsu Veterinary Clinic, which revealed no significant abnormalities.
Sub-carpal nerve blocks were subsequently performed; however, bilateral forelimb lameness persisted.
Exploratory radiographs of the proximal forelimbs were then taken, identifying a suspected proximomedial radial subchondral bone cyst in the left elbow. Radiographs of the right forelimb revealed no abnormalities.
The images have been referred to Shadai Clinic for a second opinion, and we are currently awaiting their diagnosis and recommendations regarding possible surgical intervention or further treatment options.
